root_cause.text: The `rkcif_mipi_get_reg` and `rkcif_mipi_id_get_reg` functions in the Rockchip RKCIF driver used incorrect greater-than (`>`) comparisons instead of greater-than-or-equal-to (`>=`) comparisons when validating array indices, leading to off-by-one out-of-bounds array accesses.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff shows that the boundary checks `block > RKCIF_MIPI_MAX - RKCIF_MIPI_BASE`, `index > RKCIF_MIPI_REGISTER_MAX`, `id > RKCIF_ID_MAX`, and `index > RKCIF_MIPI_ID_REGISTER_MAX` were replaced with `>=` checks using `ARRAY_SIZE` to prevent accessing elements beyond the end of the `blocks`, `regs`, `regs_id`, and `regs_id[id]` arrays.
